name: human-microbiome-function-mining
description: Human microbiome function discovery: target enzyme / EC / reaction to candidate microbial proteins, evidence integration, ranking, hypotheses, and wet-lab experimental design.

interface.shortDescription: Mine candidate microbial enzymes from a target enzyme/reaction
interface.longDescription: Organizes human microbiome enzyme mining: standardize a target enzyme input, prepare candidate genomes/proteomes, deduplicate with CD-HIT, screen with DIAMOND, collect structure evidence through US-align, use DEER as a fallback, validate with FedKEA, audit literature, rank candidates, and generate falsifiable hypotheses plus wet-lab experimental design.
defaultPrompt: Mine human microbiome proteins for a target enzyme sequence or EC number.
Find gut microbiome candidates for this enzyme reaction.
Rank candidate microbial enzymes and draft an experimental validation plan.
